_about: Every course with Language Lab labs: its language, lab type, status, theme and due day and time. The console's Student view reads this; theme and status can be changed there or in the website editor › Lab courses. status: approved = built from labs/courses/<code> and live under instructions/<code>/; proposal = still with faculty (link only); planned = a slot for the future.

d2l._note: Where the D2L loader (instructions/d2l/lab-page.html) was uploaded in D2L, as the iframe code should point at it. lab-page.html = the top of each course's files. With a Shared Files folder, e.g. /shared/LanguageLab/lab-page.html.
